comments.body_html: I don’t know if it was a mistake during installation or if it’s just a problem with the mod itself but there isn’t a priest bottom. This means that any default bottom you might have before equipping the skin (like USEC standard) will clip through it. Since the skin itself covers everything, a simple fix could be to make a blank, invisible bottom or to separate a part of the skin to be the bottom. As it stands, tho, probably won’t be using the priest option much because of this.
